title: spec: a formula field cannot declare a currency result — `returnType` is `number | text | boolean | date`, so a formula over money renders as a bare number
body:
Filing gate ①: a missing declaration measured at a public door (finding B-15). Filed by the triage seat (seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015, `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U`), splitting objectstack-ai/objectstack#22722 (the maintainer's HotCRM browser pass, objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2058, measured on `@objectstack/*` 17.7.0). ⛔ Not a claim.

## Read on objectstack `main` `f66fdc7973`

- `packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts` (about `:1717`): `returnType: z.enum(['number', 'text', 'boolean', 'date'])`. There is no currency (or percent) result and no currency source for a formula.
- objectui's `FormulaCellRenderer` says outright that a formula over currency fields "renders as a number here, not as money".

## Done when

- A formula declares a currency result, with the currency taken from the field's own config or from the source field, the same way a currency field carries it. Authoring stamps it when the inferred type is provably money.
- `Clause-②: yes (widening)`, with an ADR-0087 entry if the conversion rules require one.
- Pins:
  - a formula over a currency field declares the currency result;
  - CONTROL: a numeric formula stays `number`.

**Foreseen follow-up, filed beside this:** objectui formats it (`pm:on-hold` until a spec release carries it).

`domain:spec` · p3.
